principles: The editable canonical source is authoritative; all runtime meshes and texture maps are discardable derived artifacts.
A hand-shaped control mesh is allowed and preferred when it is the most reliable way to lock a subtype silhouette.
Procedural changes operate on named, bounded modifier parameters and must re-pass the selected morphology subtype contract.
Manual geometry changes create a new source revision and must re-pass geology, morphology, topology, UV, bake, and visual gates.
Arbitrary edits that leave the subtype envelope are never clamped or relabeled silently; they are rejected or explicitly reclassified.
One world unit equals one metre in every source, compiler, bake, and export stage.

requiredFiles.name: source-manifest.json
requiredFiles.role: identity, provenance, units, hashes, revisions, subtype, lithology, and artifact graph

requiredFiles.name: control-cage.glb
requiredFiles.role: human-editable canonical silhouette and major structural planes

requiredFiles.name: recipe.json
requiredFiles.role: geology recipe, dimensions in metres, fabrics, processes, and compiler inputs

requiredFiles.name: modifier-stack.json
requiredFiles.role: ordered procedural edits with profile IDs and safe parameter bounds

requiredFiles.name: identity-landmarks.json
requiredFiles.role: silhouette landmarks, supports, openings, crests, toes, seams, and subtype metrics

optionalFiles.name: manual-high.glb
optionalFiles.role: manually edited high-detail source override when edits cannot be represented on the control cage

optionalFiles.name: manual-delta.glb
optionalFiles.role: vertex or sculpt delta tied to an exact source revision and topology hash

optionalFiles.name: authored-masks.exr
optionalFiles.role: non-destructive geology-space masks such as protected caprock, cave roof, wetness exclusion, or seam zones

optionalFiles.name: reference-manifest.json
optionalFiles.role: rights-cleared nature references and reviewer decisions

revisionGraph.derivedArtifactRule: Every output records the exact source revision, compiler version, recipe hash, modifier-stack hash, and bake profile.

editModes.input: control-cage plus recipe plus modifier stack
blocked: topology mutation not declared by subtype
editModes.commit: compile high detail, validate subtype, then rebake

editModes.input: control-cage revision with stable metre scale and named landmarks
allowed: vertex, edge, face, landmark, and structural-plane edits
addition or deletion of cage topology with a new topology hash
editModes.commit: rebuild geology fields and high detail from the edited cage, validate subtype, then rebake

editModes.input: manual-high.glb tied to an exact parent revision
editModes.commit: validate high source directly, regenerate low mesh and UVs, then rebake all maps

allowed: edits outside the original subtype envelope
blocked: keeping the old subtype after identity failure
editModes.commit: select and approve a new subtype or create a reviewed taxonomy extension before rebake

compileGraph.output: unit-normalized source package in formation-local geology space
resolved control shape and manual override layers
subtype metrics, forbidden-drift results, supports, openings, and landmark integrity
high-resolution neutral geometry with lithology, fabric, fracture, weathering, and process fields
watertightness or declared terrain boundaries, finite features, support stability, metre scale, and geometry hashes
topology-qualified low mesh or Nanite-ready production mesh with explicit LOD policy
non-overlapping production UVs with measured texel density and padding
normal, height, ambient occlusion, base color, roughness, metalness, and packed ORM maps
projection coverage, tangent consistency, seams, dilation, range, and determinism evidence
nature-reference, clay, baked neutral, and optionally stylized comparison renders
new derived-artifact revision; previous valid output remains available until success

bakeProfiles.purpose: fast silhouette and projection diagnosis only
default prop and reusable module output after measured texel-density qualification
hero prop, outcrop, cliff module, and close camera output
large hero modules only when measured screen coverage and memory budget justify it

requiredPerSubtype: minimum safe procedural variation to rebake
maximum safe procedural variation to rebake
out-of-envelope edit rejected or explicitly reclassified
deterministic rebuild of an unchanged source revision
roundTripQualification.successRule: Passing the compiler is necessary but never substitutes for morphology and visual approval.

runtimeResize.insideQualifiedEnvelope: runtime transform is allowed without rebake
runtimeResize.toonLabEditorOutsideEnvelope: temporary preview followed by regenerate-and-rebake on commit
runtimeResize.externalSceneOutsideEnvelope: quality is not guaranteed and no automatic rebake occurs
runtimeResize.futurePlugin: may call the same content-addressed offline compiler and atomically swap the validated result
